entries.dialogueText: “The first faction is in favour of enlarging the armed forces by enlisting more men while the second faction is in favour of purchasing better military equipment instead.”

entries.dialogueText: “What is the argument for purchasing better equipment?”

entries.dialogueText: “I don't think investing in better equipment is the way. It won't matter if the enemy outnumbers us.”
entries.menuText: “I don't think investing in better equipment is the way.”

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: “A vast Armed Forces is my preference. Quantity over quality in this case.”
entries.menuText: “A vast Armed Forces is my preference.”

entries.title: Player: "“I'm not so convinced on this. What..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm not so convinced on this. What other reasons are there?”
entries.menuText: “I'm not so convinced on this.”

entries.dialogueText: “I have settled on a decision.”
entries.menuText: “I have settled on a decision.”

entries.dialogueText: “We are heading to an era of modern combat which requires modern tools to adapt.”

entries.dialogueText: “I hope the decision is in the interest of all.”

entries.dialogueText: “I'd like to extend my thanks for your attendance.”

entries.title: Player: "“Have a good day."
entries.dialogueText: “Have a good day.

entries.menuText: “Relieving half the armed forces sounds risky at best and destructive at worst.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Go on.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Go on.”
entries.menuText: “Go on.”

entries.dialogueText: Valken's eyes widened.

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“We are barely matching the size of..."
entries.dialogueText: “We are barely matching the size of half our neighbours while the other half have armies two times bigger than ours.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger

entries.dialogueText: “How on earth would discharging half the armed forces and buying new gear solve our defense issues?”

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: “A better equipped smaller force is much more preferable.”

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: “Valken raises valid questions.”
entries.menuText: “Valken raises valid questions.”

entries.menuText: “Reduce size and buy better equipment with surplus. Let's reform the army and create a smaller better equipped force.”

entries.dialogueText: “Unfortunate but as you wish, Mr. President.”

entries.dialogueText: “I can hardly say that I welcome this change.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“You have broken promises but I did..."
entries.dialogueText: “You have broken promises but I did not expect you to betray the military.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea

entries.dialogueText: “Do not expect the Sordish Armed Forces to be a capable force after these budget changes.”

entries.dialogueText: “Gentlemen. Please. Let's calm down. No need to cause a ruckus.”

entries.dialogueText: “Tell that to the hundreds of thousands that will lose their employment and the honorable general staff of the Armed Forces.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger

entries.dialogueText: “You don't mean it but it has been done.”

entries.menuText: “The Armed Forces is not as important as it claims to be. Therefore the right choice has been made.”

entries.dialogueText: “We mean no insult to the Armed Forces. There are simply no resources left.”
entries.menuText: “We mean no insult to the Armed Forces. There are simply no resources left.”

entries.dialogueText: “What will you do when a defense threat emerges? Call the police?”

entries.dialogueText: “We expected much more from you, Mr. President. You have let us down.”

entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for keeping your promises.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea

entries.dialogueText: “Know that I won't ever forget your great deed.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger

entries.dialogueText: “Our enemies are both outside and inside the country.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“I have some suggestions already.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I have some suggestions already.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger

entries.dialogueText: “Using funds to boost our size would minimize their advantage.”

entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“The 1st Army is stationed at the L..."
entries.dialogueText: “The 1st Army is stationed at the Lespia and Wehlen borders to protect the way into the central regions of Sordland.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“Rumburg fields six active field ar..."
entries.dialogueText: “Rumburg fields six active field armies and two reserve armies, together surpassing one million soldiers in the field. Lespia maintains five armies. With ATO deployments included, their numbers rise to nearly 800,000.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“Our navy is dwarfed by the Valgsla..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our navy is dwarfed by the Valgslandian fleet, which numbers 194 ships. Agnolia fields 81 vessels. They also maintain strong coastal defenses and heavy naval guns guarding their shores.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“The truth is, we are limited to ou..."
entries.dialogueText: “The truth is, we are limited to our near region due to the size and technological level of our naval ships.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“How does our Navy compare to other..."
entries.dialogueText: “How does our Navy compare to others?”
entries.menuText: “How does our Navy compare to others?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“How are our capabilities in power..."
entries.dialogueText: “How are our capabilities in power projection?”
entries.menuText: “How are our capabilities in power projection?”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“This does cause some issues like f..."
entries.dialogueText: “This does cause some issues like friendly fire and missed close air support opportunities.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What is the situation of our army?..."
entries.dialogueText: “What is the situation of our army?”
entries.menuText: “What is the situation of our army?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let's talk about our navy.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let's talk about our navy.”
entries.menuText: “Let's talk about our navy.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“Our pilots have average experience..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our pilots have average experience. They have a total of 450 hours flight time with their craft before they are qualified. This gives them more than enough time to get used to it.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“Our planes can bomb targets within..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our planes can bomb targets within 400 km radius of their airfield. They have medium range and semi-effective night-time bombing capabilities.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What are our operational capabilit..."
entries.dialogueText: “What are our operational capabilities?”
entries.menuText: “What are our operational capabilities?”

entries.speaker: Player

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“We are patrolling the Markian Sea,..."
entries.dialogueText: “We are patrolling the Markian Sea, the Grey Strait and the Antacean Sea.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“The Air Force is trained as an ind..."
entries.dialogueText: “The Air Force is trained as an independent tactical support branch which means it assists other branches but doesn't collaborate.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“How does our air force work togeth..."
entries.dialogueText: “How does our air force work together with other military branches?”
entries.menuText: “How does our air force work together with other military branches?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I am curious about another branch...."
entries.dialogueText: “I am curious about another branch.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“To make up for our lack of modern..."
entries.dialogueText: “To make up for our lack of modern military equipment, we resort to a large number of soldiers which is not really a long term solution.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“There are ways to improve collabor..."
entries.dialogueText: “There are ways to improve collaboration with joint operation rooms. Something to think about surely.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“I have been trying hard to reduce..."
entries.dialogueText: “I have been trying hard to reduce the negative effects of this problem. We don't need a modernisation program. A standardized purchase of lacking equipment would do.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Our navy currently constitutes 59..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our navy currently constitutes 59 vessels with a total of 60.000 sailors and support staff.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“We need more funding towards expan..."
entries.dialogueText: “We need more funding towards expanding the military size. Otherwise, our army will be seen as weak.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“The 3rd Army is near the Agnolian..."
entries.dialogueText: “The 3rd Army is near the Agnolian border and the coastal areas facing Valgsland.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Which is a good amount. The real i..."
entries.dialogueText: “Which is a good amount. The real issue we are having is the quality, not quantity.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“Due to our bitter past our coastal..."
entries.dialogueText: “Due to our bitter past our coastal defense force is always on alert. The decimation of our fleet still is not forgotten.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“Normally the hours per pilot shoul..."
entries.dialogueText: “Normally the hours per pilot should be higher but due to the lack of funding we can't increase the training times. Fuel costs are rather high.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“The 2nd Army has a large mountain..."
entries.dialogueText: “The 2nd Army has a large mountain commando force and it is the most adequately equipped army to face Rumburg.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“Valgsland fields one active army o..."
entries.dialogueText: “Valgsland fields one active army of around 140,000 troops, a significant portion of them marines. They also maintain three reserve armies that can be mobilized quickly due to their rapid mobilization military structure.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Very well.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Very well.”
entries.menuText: “Very well.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Which one?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Which one?”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“At any-time we can field seven air..."
entries.dialogueText: “At any-time we can field seven air wings composing a total of 130 aircraft that can operate in combat duty. This is enough to subdue most targets.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Any specific one you want to know..."
entries.dialogueText: “Any specific one you want to know about?”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“As you know, these ships are comma..."
entries.dialogueText: “As you know, these ships are commanded from our main naval base in Conriat where our flagship, SN Renan is docked.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“30.000 pilots and support staff wo..."
entries.dialogueText: “30.000 pilots and support staff work in the Air Force and they are commanded from the Mark Air Force Base in Erlory.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Let's.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let's.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Rumburg’s sheer size stems from it..."
entries.dialogueText: “Rumburg’s sheer size stems from its forced conscription laws. In addition, several ducal regions maintain their own forces at their own expense, further bolstering the crown’s strength. They can sustain this scale thanks to their vast gold reserves, much of which flowed in from Rizia over the past decades.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“The Lespian army is the most advan..."
entries.dialogueText: “The Lespian army is the most advanced. Arcasian investment and the Alvarez administration’s expansion of the military-industrial complex have accelerated their modernization.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I am not interested in the details..."
entries.dialogueText: “I am not interested in the details.”
entries.menuText: “I am not interested in the details.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“Lespia’s navy, while smaller at 39..."
entries.dialogueText: “Lespia’s navy, while smaller at 39 ships, is heavily modernized and highly capable. That figure excludes the ATO fleet of Arcasia, which stations another 35 ships in Falenco and San Mantua.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Our air force currently has 410 pl..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our air force currently has 410 planes in the inventory. Out of which only 140 are jet planes that are not in great condition.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Another thing to note is; after th..."
entries.dialogueText: “Another thing to note is; after the takeover of Heljiland where our navy has led incursion operations to protect Agnolia, we also take part in some joint navy drills as well.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“If we had modern support vessels,..."
entries.dialogueText: “If we had modern support vessels, we could participate in international operations.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“If we are to build a truly effecti..."
entries.dialogueText: “If we are to build a truly effective navy, our ships must be equipped with modern radar and sonar systems. Adding outdated vessels to the roster would change little.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I would like to know about the oth..."
entries.dialogueText: “I would like to know about the other branches.”
entries.menuText: “I would like to know about the other branches.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“We often patrol the routes that ar..."
entries.dialogueText: “We often patrol the routes that are close to the shipping lanes. Especially Markian Sea and Grey Strait. The amount of cargo that goes through that area is eye opening.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“Our navy protects all our coastal..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our navy protects all our coastal regions however, to make sure we are not thinning out our defense, we prioritise certain regions over others. Like Greater Holsord.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“In terms of our bombing capability..."
entries.dialogueText: “In terms of our bombing capability, we have an average of 100 meters of precision. This is not great but it is still within the effective radius of the bombs.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let's hear about the other branche..."
entries.dialogueText: “Let's hear about the other branches of the armed forces.”
entries.menuText: “Let's hear about the other branches of the armed forces.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“We have prepared a briefing to con..."
entries.dialogueText: “We have prepared a briefing to convey further details about the current situation of our military.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“General Valken. Mr. Lancea. Let's..."
entries.dialogueText: “General Valken. Mr. Lancea. Let's start with the briefing.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "To determine the current situation..."
entries.dialogueText: To determine the current situation of the military and its spending policy, we held a meeting in the White Room.

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“Very well, Mr. Vice President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Very well, Mr. Vice President.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Actually, let's move on.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Actually, let's move on.”
entries.menuText: “Actually, let's move on.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“The 2nd Army, our largest force, h..."
entries.dialogueText: “The 2nd Army, our largest force, has been situated by the Rumburg border.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“As you can see, the situation is s..."
entries.dialogueText: “As you can see, the situation is serious. But the solution is not simply to commission more hulls.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“That's right. We still hold *some*..."
entries.dialogueText: “That's right. We still hold *some* power though. If needed be, we could block the trade at the Markian Sea.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“To make up for our weakness, allyi..."
entries.dialogueText: “To make up for our weakness, allying ourselves to a naval power could also help protect our seas.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“No need to go into details. I have..."
entries.dialogueText: “No need to go into details. I have already settled on a decision.”
entries.menuText: “No need to go into details. I have already settled on a decision.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“No use complaining now, Valken. Le..."
entries.dialogueText: “No use complaining now, Valken. Let's look at what we can do with what we have.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Quality over quantity. I like it.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Quality over quantity. I like it.”
entries.menuText: “Quality over quantity. I like it.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“What do you think, Mr. President?”"
entries.dialogueText: “What do you think, Mr. President?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Dismissed.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Dismissed.”
entries.menuText: “Dismissed.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef let out a long sigh."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef let out a long sigh.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“That will be all for today then.”"
entries.dialogueText: “That will be all for today then.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“First off, we have received an upd..."
entries.dialogueText: “First off, we have received an updated communication from the Arcasian military command.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Their planes are being moved into..."
entries.dialogueText: “Their planes are being moved into Erlory airbase as we speak.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Under our supervision of course.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Under our supervision of course.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Good. Make sure you keep an eye on..."
entries.dialogueText: “Good. Make sure you keep an eye on them.”
entries.menuText: “Good. Make sure you keep an eye on them.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Do your best to make them feel at..."
entries.dialogueText: “Do your best to make them feel at home.”
entries.menuText: “Do your best to make them feel at home.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Ensure that they do not forget whi..."
entries.dialogueText: “Ensure that they do not forget which country's soil they are on.”
entries.menuText: “Ensure that they do not forget which country's soil they are on.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“Of course, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Of course, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“We will try our best.”"
entries.dialogueText: “We will try our best.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef and Valken looked at each oth..."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef and Valken looked at each other.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“First off, we have received an upd..."
entries.dialogueText: “First off, we have received an updated communication from the United Contanan military command.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“We are keeping them under close su..."
entries.dialogueText: “We are keeping them under close surveillance.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Ensure that they do not forget whi..."
entries.dialogueText: “Ensure that they do not forget which country's soil they are on.”
entries.menuText: “Ensure that they do not forget which country's soil they are on.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“Of course, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Of course, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Good. Make sure you keep an eye on..."
entries.dialogueText: “Good. Make sure you keep an eye on them.”
entries.menuText: “Good. Make sure you keep an eye on them.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“We will try our best.”"
entries.dialogueText: “We will try our best.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Do your best to make them feel at..."
entries.dialogueText: “Do your best to make them feel at home.”
entries.menuText: “Do your best to make them feel at home.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef and Valken looked at each oth..."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef and Valken looked at each other.

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“A single wrong move and we will-”"
entries.dialogueText: “A single wrong move and we will-”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Despite my very vocal disagreement..."
entries.dialogueText: “Despite my very vocal disagreement with the plan, their warships are approaching the Conriat naval base as we speak.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“Contanan warships in Conriat. I th..."
entries.dialogueText: “Contanan warships in Conriat. I thought I would never see the day.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“We will keep you updated.”"
entries.dialogueText: “We will keep you updated.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Do not cause any trouble. Do you u..."
entries.dialogueText: “Do not cause any trouble. Do you understand?”
entries.menuText: “Do not cause any trouble. Do you understand?”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“Yes, sir.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, sir.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Now let's move on to our military...."
entries.dialogueText: “Now let's move on to our military.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“As if the reduction was not enough..."
entries.dialogueText: “As if the reduction was not enough, you also decided against reinforcing our border.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef narrowed his eyes."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef narrowed his eyes.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“If I didn't know better, I would s..."
entries.dialogueText: “If I didn't know better, I would say you are intentionally trying to weaken Sordland, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Of course not. How can you even su..."
entries.dialogueText: “Of course not. How can you even suggest that?”
entries.menuText: “Of course not. How can you even suggest that?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You dare accuse me of treachery, I..."
entries.dialogueText: “You dare accuse me of treachery, Iosef?”
entries.menuText: “You dare accuse me of treachery, Iosef?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We are sorry but this had to be do..."
entries.dialogueText: “We are sorry but this had to be done.”
entries.menuText: “We are sorry but this had to be done.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Cause and effect. That's how I can..."
entries.dialogueText: “Cause and effect. That's how I can suggest that.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Ridiculous.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Ridiculous.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He did not respond."
entries.dialogueText: He did not respond.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We stared down each other. Petr fin..."
entries.dialogueText: We stared down each other. Petr finally interjected.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Let's calm down, gentlemen.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let's calm down, gentlemen.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef's voice was getting louder an..."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef's voice was getting louder and louder.

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“If Rumburg were to attack we would..."
entries.dialogueText: “If Rumburg were to attack we would need to sacrifice many soldiers to hold the line now.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“This will help our defensive situa..."
entries.dialogueText: “This will help our defensive situation to some degree. Units have already built dozens of pillboxes and trenches with tank traps. But it is not enough.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“At the very least you decided to f..."
entries.dialogueText: “At the very least you decided to fund our new border fortifications against Rumburg.”

entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“Wehlen commands two armies totalin..."
entries.dialogueText: “Wehlen commands two armies totaling roughly 300,000 soldiers, though only their professional core is considered highly capable. Agnolia fields three armies amounting to 250,000 troops. They are well equipped, but have not seen combat in over three decades.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Valgsland follows closely. Althoug..."
entries.dialogueText: “Valgsland follows closely. Although they prioritize economic development and social welfare in their budget, CSP funding has allowed them to remain competitive, keeping the gap with Lespia narrow.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“Rumburg maintains 94 naval vessels..."
entries.dialogueText: “Rumburg maintains 94 naval vessels. Intelligence suggests nearly a third of those are submarines. They also rely on other GRACE nations to help secure maritime routes and protect their trade networks abroad.”
